title: Two Cities Went to War and the Winner Took a Bucket #history #shorts
description:
In 1325, Bologna and Modena went to war. The cause was a betrayed fortress, not a bucket. Modena won the only battle, at Zappolino, chased Bologna's army home, held a race outside its gates, and carried off a wooden bucket from a well as a trophy. Three hundred years later a poet's comic epic made the bucket the cause of the war, and that's the version everyone remembers. The bucket is still in Modena.

The scenes are an animated dramatization.

#history #shorts #italy #medieval
comment: Should Modena ever give Bologna its bucket back?
